{{Quote|They have formed their own pathetic civilization from scraps of the shining world that has been forever forbidden to them.|[[Pollux Hax/Legends|Pollux Hax]]|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
'''Cthons''', also known as '''Troglodytes''', were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] troglodytic [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] living in the lowest levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]].

==Biology and appearance==
Visually, Cthons resembled decaying corpses with loose flaps of flesh, stringy, dirty hair, and a lipless mouth filled with sharp teeth. Skin grew to cover their eyes; there was an egg-like organ where the eye could be seen moving restlessly while sealed within its sockets. If clothed at all, they wore nothing but simple loincloths. They were zombie-like [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] who preyed on living flesh.

==History==
Their ancestors were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who were banished from the surface for their crimes, subsequently residing in the darkness of the undercity for thousands of years, which genetically changed them into terrifying creatures that became the subject of countless horror stories and nightmares.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

A [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] smuggler once stated the pain from having the [[Noetikon of Light]] implanted in his body was worse than an infected Cthon bite, much to the horror of [[Qyzen Fess]], who had once suffered from the latter.

Cthons were also known to use [[electroshock net]]s to catch their prey, as demonstrated on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darsha Assant]] and her companions, [[I-5YQ]] and [[Lorn Pavan]].<ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Cthons were said to be the analog of the [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] [[Rakghoul]] of the [[Undercity (Taris)|Taris Undercity]] and perhaps may be related to the underlevels' [[Corridor ghoul/Legends|corridor ghouls]].

Cthons were also used as slaves by the [[Flesh Raider]]s of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Some of these Cthons would burrow underground and then burst from the ground and attack when an enemy approached their Flesh Raider masters. It is unknown how these Cthons arrived on Tython, though these Cthons were purple-grey in color instead of the normal white.

Following [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], one of the few surviving Jedi was [[Sha Koon]], who attempted to kill [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] by luring him into an ambush. By using the Force, she manipulated the Cthon into attacking the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], but they were easily dispatched.
